source_uncertainty.statement: It is unresolved whether the local wall-sector organization visible in P4 can correspond consistently to the local wall-sector organization visible in P5.
source_uncertainty.selection_note: No unique globally best inter-view uncertainty is established. This bounded P4/P5 test is selected because both views have persisted structured observations and multiple visible local-layout properties, and a result can constrain two sets of already acquired spatial relations without inventing a new observation.

hypotheses_or_alternatives.meaning: The authorized visible local-layout properties admit a correspondence between the P4 and P5 wall sectors without a directly visible conflicting invariant. This is not SAME_PHYSICAL_OBJECT.

At least one authorized, directly visible local-layout property has mutually exclusive observable states across P4 and P5 that cannot be explained by framing/occlusion within the authorized pixels. This is evidence against this correspondence only.

discriminating_properties.instruction: Compare only directly visible qualitative ordering and relative placement of wall openings inside each authorized wall-sector ROI. Determine whether a mapping can be supported or visibly conflicts. Do not treat an opening missing from one crop as absent.
Compare the qualitative position of authorized visible openings relative to the visible sloping roof/eave boundary where both are inspectable. Use boundary/order evidence only.

Inspect directly visible opening structure (for example panel/shutter/recess configuration) only where the authorized ROIs expose it. Use it only if the property is genuinely comparable across both views; visual resemblance alone is not correspondence.

Inspect whether visible neighboring boundaries within the wall sectors provide a distinctive qualitative ordering that would be compatible or incompatible across the two views. Do not infer hidden continuation or 3D geometry.

response_invariants: Inspect only authorized photos, observations and ROIs; do not create observations.
Do not answer SAME_PHYSICAL_OBJECT or DISTINCT_PHYSICAL_OBJECTS. The request tests only whether the visible local-layout correspondence is compatible or incompatible.
Visual similarity alone can never produce CORRESPONDENCE_COMPATIBLE; the result must use discriminating local organization, ordering, boundary or configuration evidence.
CORRESPONDENCE_INCOMPATIBLE requires a directly visible mutually exclusive discriminating property; non-visibility, crop difference or occlusion is insufficient.
AMBIGUOUS remains required when relevant pixels admit multiple mappings or interpretations.
NOT_OBSERVABLE remains required when authorized pixels do not expose a property reliably enough to compare.
Every property_result property_token must come from discriminating_properties and every relation token must be allowed.
Every provenance ROI must exactly equal one authorized ROI for every observation_ref it cites, and photo_index must match that observation.
Do not infer metric geometry, camera pose, depth, hidden continuation, or physical identity across P3/P4/P5.
Do not use prior prose as pixel evidence. Prior structured state only defines what is worth testing.
